_about: Optional. Name this file in job-search.env as TRACKER_SETTINGS. It holds what one person's older records need, so the scripts stay the same for everyone. Every key is optional.

sync._about: track.py sync. merge: search-result files ({companies: [...]}) joined to the tracker, each with an origin label. labels: agent-label prefixes per kind of result, newest run first (defaults: exclusion = excl-judge:, excl-verify:, excl-screen:; own = excl-own:; prep = prep-jobs:; screen and refute = none). refute_incomplete: companies whose 'incomplete' screen takes the refuting check's verdict. verdict_overrides: company -> [verdict, why]. exclude_overrides: company -> why it is excluded.

Example Group: owner not public; the person decides

exclude_overrides.Example Bank: excluded by the person's rule R2 (source: ...)
